_doc: Trace lines on the world-frame drawing views by snapping rough guide points onto the drawing's ink.

rear_glass.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z

rear_spoiler_top.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z
rear_spoiler_top.note: roof spoiler top edge = roof silhouette at the rear

rear_spoiler_bottom.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z

rear_c_pillar.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z
rear_c_pillar.note: outermost C-pillar line from roof to belt; several parallel lines here, check overlay

rear_body_sil.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z
rear_body_sil.note: body half-width silhouette below the belt

rear_lamp.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z
rear_lamp.note: tail lamp outline (facelift lens, same aperture)

rear_panel_recess.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z
rear_panel_recess.note: black panel / plate recess outer edge

rear_tailgate_bottom.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z
rear_tailgate_bottom.note: horizontal line below the glass, tailgate lower edge?

rear_bumper_top.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z

rear_bumper_bottom.axes: u = -x (right = -x, seen from behind), v = z

front_roof_sil.axes: u = x (right = +x, seen from the front), v = z
front_roof_sil.note: roof silhouette into the outer A-pillar line

front_screen_header.axes: u = x (right = +x, seen from the front), v = z
front_screen_header.note: screen top edge (upper of the two lines)

side_tail_centre.note: outermost tail silhouette in side view = the tailgate/backlight centreline profile [y, z]

plan_front_corner.axes: u = y (right = rearward), v = x (DOWN = +x, the car's left)
plan_front_corner.note: front bumper / wing corner in plan [y, x] (facelift bumper)

plan_rear_corner.axes: u = y (right = rearward), v = x (DOWN = +x, the car's left)
plan_rear_corner.note: rear bumper / quarter corner in plan [y, x]

front_body_sil.axes: u = x (right = +x, seen from the front), v = z
